t: Healing the Trunk: A Case Study in AI-Assisted Refactoring
s: This case study details the refactoring of Pipulate's browser automation system, focusing on rebuilding its 'recipe' system for reliability and robustness. It introduces concepts like FastHTML, AI-assisted development, and the 'Origin' for organizing automation.
sub: Pipulate framework architecture (FastHTML, Python templating, AI-assisted automation)
Refactoring browser automation recipes for reliability and robustness
AI-Human collaboration in technical debt resolution
The 'Origin' concept for organizing web application targets
Philosophy of simplicity and 'baby steps' in development
